description: Ross's mistaken name at the altar fractures his marriage to Emily while Monica and Chandler hide a relationship that steadily becomes serious, Phoebe gives birth to the triplets and the group ultimately converges on Las Vegas.

s05e01.description: Ross's disastrous wedding leaves Emily humiliated, Rachel caught in the middle and the newlyweds trying to decide whether their marriage can survive his accidental declaration.

s05e02.description: Monica and Chandler struggle to keep their new relationship secret, while Rachel realizes that her habit of kissing everyone goodbye is making their cover harder to maintain.

s05e03.description: Phoebe goes into labor with the triplets she is carrying for Frank and Alice, while Joey develops severe sympathy pains and Monica and Chandler nearly expose their secret.

s05e04.description: Joey's PBS telethon appearance sparks an argument with Phoebe about whether truly selfless good deeds exist, while Monica tries to prove Chandler is becoming too comfortable in their secret romance.

s05e05.description: Monica and Chandler take a secret weekend away but keep running into complications, while Joey notices he is being excluded and fears he is becoming the group's new 'Kip.'

s05e06.description: Emily agrees to stay married to Ross only if he cuts Rachel out of his life, while Monica and Rachel mistake a strange-looking neighbor for a dangerous intruder.

s05e07.description: Ross moves in with Joey and Chandler after his marriage collapses, quickly irritating both roommates with his habits while Phoebe dates a health inspector whose work ruins restaurants.

s05e08.description: The friends trade stories of disastrous past Thanksgivings, revealing old humiliations, Monica's accidental injury to Chandler and the moment their relationship finally becomes impossible to deny emotionally.

s05e09.description: Ross reaches breaking point when someone at work eats Monica's special Thanksgiving sandwich, while Joey keeps taking the blame for Monica and Chandler's secret affair.

s05e10.description: Rachel dates Danny but becomes increasingly unsettled by his unusually intimate relationship with his sister, while Phoebe causes trouble while collecting holiday donations.

s05e11.description: The group makes New Year's resolutions, leading Ross into leather pants, Rachel into gossip trouble and Chandler into an increasingly painful attempt to stop making jokes.

s05e12.description: Monica discovers Chandler has a fake laugh and an ingratiating work persona around his boss, while Ross learns Emily is remarrying and reacts badly.

s05e13.description: Joey becomes attached to a stylish shoulder bag for an audition despite the others' teasing, while Phoebe introduces her grandmother to the group and learns more about her family.

s05e14.description: Phoebe and Rachel discover Monica and Chandler are together and launch a game of seduction and bluffing to force them to confess before the couple realizes what is happening.

s05e15.description: Joey dates a woman who playfully punches him hard enough to hurt, while Ross's new neighbors resent him for refusing to contribute to a building handyman's farewell gift.

s05e16.description: Phoebe finds a police badge and begins using it until she meets its owner, Gary, while Joey becomes convinced Monica and Chandler are losing their old friendship with him.

s05e17.description: Rachel accidentally kisses her prospective boss during an interview and then makes matters worse trying to explain it, while Joey becomes obsessed with a woman living across the street.

s05e18.description: Rachel starts smoking to avoid being excluded from important conversations with her boss, while Joey and Ben compete for an acting job and Monica and Phoebe plan Rachel's birthday.

s05e19.description: Ross tries disastrously to flirt with a pizza delivery woman, while Joey's visiting grandmother waits impatiently to see his television appearance.

s05e20.description: Ross, Joey and Chandler join Gary on a police ride-along, where a sudden noise makes Joey instinctively protect Ross and sends Chandler into a spiral about their friendship.

s05e21.description: Gary asks Phoebe to move in with him, while Joey and Ross become absurdly committed to keeping a ball in the air and Rachel buys a hairless cat she quickly regrets.

s05e22.description: Joey gets his first major movie role and drives to Las Vegas, only to discover the production has shut down, while Phoebe is angry that Ross doubts she ever had a long-distance trip.

s05e23.description: The group heads to Las Vegas, where Joey hides the collapse of his movie, Monica and Chandler gamble on their future and Ross humiliates Rachel during the flight.

s05e24.description: A drunken Ross and Rachel roam the casino after escalating their prank war, while Monica and Chandler nearly marry before discovering that Ross and Rachel have beaten them to it.
